skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to draft legal documents such as laws, decrees, regulations, etc.
Students will be able to analyze legal documents for compliance with legal standards.
Students will be able to present their work effectively in group settings.
Students will be able to collaborate effectively in teams.
Students will develop the ability to independently research and learn about legal document drafting.
Students will be able to critically think about legal issues and solutions.
Students will gain foundational knowledge about legal documents and the process of drafting them.
Students will improve their proficiency in legal language and terminology.
